metadata.purpose: Validate canonical BB16 model integrity before jurisdiction-specific checks.

rules.title: Project identifier present
rules.description: The model must contain a non-empty project identifier.
rules.failure_message: The model has no usable project identifier.

rules.title: Schema version present
rules.description: The model must declare its schema version.
rules.failure_message: The model does not declare a schema version.

rules.title: SI unit system
rules.description: BB16 v1 uses SI as its canonical unit system.
rules.failure_message: The model is not declared in SI units.

rules.title: Level identifiers valid and unique
rules.description: At least one level with unique identifiers is required.
rules.failure_message: Levels are missing, incomplete or duplicated.

rules.title: Space identifiers unique
rules.description: Every space identifier must be unique.
rules.failure_message: Spaces contain missing or duplicate identifiers.

rules.title: Space level references valid
rules.description: Every space must reference an existing level.
rules.failure_message: One or more spaces reference an unknown level.

rules.title: Element identifiers unique
rules.description: Every building element identifier must be unique.
rules.failure_message: Elements contain missing or duplicate identifiers.

rules.title: Element level references valid
rules.description: Element level references must identify existing levels when present.
rules.failure_message: One or more elements reference an unknown level.

rules.title: Positive level heights
rules.description: Declared level heights must be greater than zero.
rules.failure_message: One or more level heights are not positive.

rules.title: Non-negative space quantities
rules.description: Declared space areas and volumes must not be negative.
rules.failure_message: One or more spaces have a negative area or volume.

rules.title: Relationship endpoints valid
rules.description: Relationships must connect known canonical objects.
rules.failure_message: One or more relationships have invalid endpoints or no type.
